CustomField.description: Leave blank for a normal record-creation column mapping (consumed by SObjectCreatorRowHandler: Excel_Column_Header__c -> Target_SObject__c/Target_Field__c). Set to turn this mapping row into an aggregation spec instead (consumed by AggregateRowHandler/FieldWriteBackResultHandler): Excel_Column_Header__c names the column to aggregate, and Target_Field__c names the field on the request's Related Record Id to write the result into. Target_SObject__c is ignored for aggregation specs since the target record already exists.
CustomField.label: Aggregate Function
